design_condition: The building is precisely aligned with the existing residential buildings at the transition to the southern sports fields, completing the school complex while preserving its outdoor qualities.

positive.statement: The project treats the existing buildings and outdoor areas respectfully and coherently.

position.rationale: Overall sampled footprint anchors the school ensemble and its southern outdoor transition.

positive.statement: The precise setting clarifies the southern area and creates a new ensemble.

position.rationale: Southern edge of the aligned footprint anchors the clarified area and ensemble.

positive.statement: The high-quality spatial references create a dialogue between inside and outside and between the existing and new buildings.

position.rationale: Central footprint location approximates the spatial interface between interior and surrounding open areas.

positive.statement: The clear structure and organization promise well-functioning and interesting school operations.

position.rationale: Linear, three-part sampled massing anchors the organizational and operational reading.

positive.statement: The basic levels have directly adjacent, spacious gardens separated from the primary school playground.

position.target: adjacent gardens and primary school playground
position.rationale: Ground-level southern-western edge provides the closest sampled anchor for gardens and playground separation.

positive.statement: The day school allows children's different activities to be spatially separated.

position.rationale: Separated footprint portions provide an approximate anchor for differentiated school activity zones.

negative.statement: The proposed muddy masonry appears foreign in the context of the existing buildings.

position.rationale: South-facing sampled envelope anchors the contextual facade-material criticism.

negative.statement: The projections, setbacks, passage, and raised roof increase insulation costs and negatively affect the energy balance.

position.target: projections, setbacks, passage, and raised roof
position.rationale: Distinct stepped and raised upper massing is visible across top and elevation projections.

negative.statement: The primary requirements for the building envelope are barely met.

position.rationale: Sampled exterior boundary provides a broad anchor for the envelope-performance criticism.
